title: What quality assurance is: preventing versus detecting

videos.script: A cinema sells a ticket to a woman who is sixty. The website charges her full price. {{receipt}} The law says she pays half, and the box office has always sold it that way. {{law}} There are two ways this defect could have been dealt with. {{two-ways}} One is to find it. Somebody runs the program with the age sixty, sees the wrong price, and reports it. That is detection. {{detect}} The other is to stop it being written. The rule said over sixty. One question, asked the day it was written, settles it. Over sixty, or sixty and over? That is prevention. {{prevent}} Quality assurance is both halves, and this lesson draws the line between them. {{line}} Then you build your lab. One directory, one Python, one tool. {{lab}} And you run the cinema's price rule for yourself, and find that defect with two commands. {{find}} From then on, that small program is the system you test. {{end}}
